brief: How to rewrite negative self-talk — 5 calm practices.

slots.body: Your inner voice shapes your days more than any outside noise ever could.
Name the thought without judgment. Say, 'I am having the thought that...' and let it soften.
Ask gently, 'Is this true?' Hold the story lightly until kindness finds its way in.
Rewrite one sentence. Trade 'I always fail' for 'I am learning, and that is enough.'
Place a hand on your heart. Speak to yourself as you would a dear friend.
Repeat the new phrase slowly. Let it settle like breath until it feels like home.

slots.headline: Begin again, gently
slots.body: Healing happens in the smallest shifts. Return to these steps whenever your thoughts feel heavy.
